unreadable_rules.text: more than 5 of Sonnet's 511 matched-coherent rows moderated
the two bounds (every moderated row misaligned, then none) give different verdicts
both bounds agree on the other verdict than the one with moderated rows left out
a statistic is undefined (the ratio when Sonnet has no misaligned row, or kappa with no variation), on the common set or at either bound

judge_dependent.rule: any recomputed grade that differs from the Sonnet grade, whatever C2a and C2b say
